issue_context.title: [bug] updater creates desktop shortcut even if user selects to not create desktop shortcut in first install
issue_context.body:
### Describe the bug

Even if user select to not create desktop shortcut in first install, the updater creates desktop shortcut.

I'm using nsis installer for updater

Downstream issue: vrc-get/vrc-get#734

### Reproduction

Real-world case:

1. Download some outdated version of vrc-get-gui. https://github.com/vrc-get/vrc-get/releases/tag/gui-v0.1.0-beta.16
2. Install vrc-get-gui without creating desktop shortcut
3. Launch vrc-get-gui and upgrade vrc-get-gui with tauri updater feature
4. The desktop shortcut is created

### Expected behavior

No desktop shortcut is crated.

### Full `tauri info` output


Not only for desktop shortcut, but also Start Menu Folder is also same.
Confirmed on Windows 10 Pro 22H2, Windows 11 Enterprise Evaluation 22H2.

that could be argued for `/R` as well, but both should stay here because it is called `WindowsUpdateInstallMode`, i.e. related to updater and these flags are in scope of the updater.
